name: cc-mods
description: Three Claude Code mods: folio shows the files of your project in a pane beside the chat, tint restyles the transcript, and reply quotes a highlight into your prompt.

plugins.name: folio
plugins.description: Read the files of your project in a calm pane beside the chat.

plugins.name: tint
plugins.description: Your message and Claude's reply as blocks, in two looks, with a status line.

plugins.name: reply
plugins.description: Highlight part of Claude's answer and reply to it. The text goes into your prompt as a quote.
